meta.label: The Desk
meta.blurb: Somebody is writing a letter on a desk the size of a parish. The pen has been put down mid-sentence. You would not like to meet the hand.

secrets.name: The Pencil Drawer
secrets.text: A drawer left open a crack. Inside, pencils as long as barges, all sharpened, and one candle somebody lit and forgot. It has been burning for a very long time.
